description: Land Title Settlement Dept - Galwewa, Beliatta D/S/D,Hambantota District (25/5514228)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively about the formal registration of land titles for specific parcels of land, including owner details, parcel numbers, and extent. It is an official declaration under the Registration of Title Act, falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes or fit any other specialized category more specifically.
